# omics-skills 1.3.0

This minor release adds project-level reproducibility to the omics skill pack
and publishes the results of a repository-wide skill and setup audit. The
package contains four agents and 35 skills for Claude Code and Codex.

## Executive summary

- Added `bioinformatics-project` as the owner of project layout, pinned
  environments, task and hypothesis records, restartable drivers, provenance,
  lab notebooks, and deposition preparation.
- Focused `bio-foundation-housekeeping` on LinkML/Pydantic validation,
  normalized Parquet tables, and DuckDB cataloging so project-setup routing has
  one owner for each concern.
- Reviewed all skills and repaired verified correctness, security, routing,
  installation, and documentation defects. `docs/skill-quality.md` records the
  per-skill findings and next implementation opportunities.
- Added native Codex TOML agent rendering and Codex plugin metadata while
  keeping Markdown agent prompts as the shared source.

## Skill and workflow corrections

- Fixed arXiv request forwarding, bioRxiv pagination, scientific-impact DOI
  enrichment, notebook execution/export, PDF remote-upload consent, and
  workflow-method validation and credential redaction.
- Removed insecure JGI Lakehouse TLS examples, tightened token handling and
  archive extraction, and added bounded requests and regression tests.
- Corrected phylogeny resume/support semantics, minimap2 option guidance,
  pangenome input handling, ML preprocessing and GPU configuration, taxonomy
  environment drift, binning scope, and gene-calling tool selection.
- Added interdomain HGT analysis, bounded literature-search behavior, Crossref
  metadata fallback, ONT failure-recovery guidance, and figure-rendering fixes.

## Routing, installation, and validation

- Expanded the routing benchmark to cover project reproducibility, schema and
  catalog work, HGT hard negatives, literature tools, and structure tools.
- Added compact description and link validation for every skill, plus an
  aggregate discovery-budget check.
- Added isolated installer tests, selected-component catalogs, native Codex
  agent rendering, scoped backups, and uninstall symmetry.
- Added Claude and Codex plugin validation and a release-note consistency test
  tied to the manifest version.

## Installation note

Run `make install` after updating. This replaces an older Control Center-owned
`bioinformatics-project` link with the version from this repository and
regenerates the Codex TOML agents and routing catalog.

## Validation

The release gate includes:

- `make test`
- `make benchmark`
- `python3 scripts/validate-skills.py`
- `python3 scripts/validate-supplementary-docs.py`
- strict MkDocs build
- Claude and Codex plugin validation
- isolated Makefile and shell-installer tests
- Ruff, Python compilation, shell syntax, catalog freshness, and diff checks
